title: Asahina Mafuyu — Break Into A Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Whoa, your lunch looks so good!
Did you make it, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, my mother made it for me.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Lucky! Your mom's such a good cook too! Can I try some of it? You can have some of mine in return...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! Mafuyu, can I have some too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Take what you like.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Amazing! *Sigh*... You get to eat stuff like this every single day. I'm so jealous.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'd like to stay here for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay...
Can I sit next to you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I keep forgetting...
You're not alone here anymore.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you not like that, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't like it when people are being loud...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But it doesn't bother me when I'm with Kanade, Rin or the others...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You changing has caused this SEKAI to change as well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I...
I don't feel any different...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Tell me, Miku. How have I changed?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You were in so much pain and had this big hole in your heart... It felt so empty...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Kanade's music started to reach you and began to fill that hole...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's not just Kanade's music either now. You have Ena and Mizuki along with Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You no longer felt alone, and I stopped being alone as a result.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Did you like being alone more, Miku...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No.
It feels warmer with everyone here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Caramel chocolates.
A girl at school gave them to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If I keep changing like this, will I know what these actually taste like in the future?)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I think I like it more than most things I've had before...
